name: BGP_Neighbors_Status_Audit
description: Monitors BGP neighbor states for all devices. Flags non-Established sessions.
sql_query: SELECT device_name, COUNT(*) as total_neighbors, COUNT(CASE WHEN state = 'Established' THEN 1 END) as established, COUNT(CASE WHEN state != 'Established' OR state IS NULL THEN 1 END) as issues, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN state != 'Established' OR state IS NULL THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as issues_pct FROM v_bgp_neighbors_auto GROUP BY device_name ORDER BY total_neighbors DESC;
